name: RSNA 2022 cervical spine fracture CT (Kaggle)
what: 2,019 cervical spine CT studies with fracture labels by vertebra, C1 to C7, and vertebra segmentations for part of them; one zip of 203,318,086,447 bytes
level_truth: fracture labels by vertebra, C1 to C7

segmentations.masks: vertebra masks for 87 of the 2,019 studies, each vertebra named by level, inside the zip, which is not unpacked; every study also has fracture labels by vertebra, C1 to C7, which are not masks
vertebra masks by TotalSegmentator and by SPINEPS with VERIDAH, each vertebra named by level, and the level call made from the two together; the folder holds this set and RibFrac together
segmentations.by: the data platform's anomaly harvest, automatic; no radiologist has read them

licence: Kaggle competition rules (non-commercial); the terms for derived labels not recorded
